Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly accepted the search result stating the 2017 US Open was the "50th edition" without verifying the logical consistency of this fact. The US Open began in 1881; by 2017, it should have been the 137th edition (2017 - 1881 + 1), not the 50th. The search snippet likely contained a typo or error (possibly confusing the edition number with another statistic or a different tournament), but the Planner failed to apply basic domain knowledge to flag this impossibility and instead concluded the task based on the erroneous number.
